questions.question: Which trophy is awarded to the NHL champion?
questions.explanation: The Stanley Cup was first awarded in 1893.

questions.question: How many players per team are on the ice in ice hockey (including the goalie)?
questions.explanation: Three forwards, two defencemen and a goalie.

questions.question: What do you call the disc used in ice hockey?
questions.explanation: The puck is made of vulcanised rubber.

questions.question: What is the player who guards the net called?
questions.explanation: Also called the goalie.

questions.question: What is a faceoff?
choices: Dropping the puck between two players to start play
questions.explanation: Faceoffs start each period and restart play.

questions.question: Which country did hockey originate in?
questions.explanation: Modern ice hockey was developed in Montreal in 1875.

questions.question: What is the Swiss hockey league called?
questions.explanation: The Swiss National League is the top tier.

questions.question: What is the Swedish top hockey league called?
questions.explanation: SHL stands for Svenska Hockeyligan.

questions.question: Which Canadian team is based in Montreal and has won 24 Stanley Cups?
questions.explanation: The Canadiens are the most successful franchise.

questions.question: Which NHL team plays in Pittsburgh?
questions.explanation: Sidney Crosby has played his whole career there.

questions.question: Who is nicknamed 'The Great One'?
questions.explanation: Gretzky holds NHL records for goals, assists and points.

questions.question: How long is a regulation NHL game?
questions.explanation: Three periods of 20 minutes.

questions.question: What is it called when a player scores three goals in one game?
questions.explanation: Fans traditionally throw hats on the ice.

questions.question: What is the offside line in hockey called?
questions.explanation: Blue lines mark the offensive zone.

questions.question: Which NHL team won the 2024 Stanley Cup?
questions.explanation: Florida beat Edmonton in seven games.

questions.question: Which team won the Stanley Cup in 2025?
questions.explanation: Florida repeated, beating Edmonton again.

questions.question: Which Olympic hockey team famously won 'The Miracle on Ice' in 1980?
questions.explanation: The US beat the USSR in Lake Placid.

questions.question: Which country won Olympic men's ice hockey gold in 2022?
questions.explanation: Finland beat ROC 2–1 in Beijing.

questions.question: Which Russian star scored 800+ NHL goals?
questions.explanation: Ovechkin broke Gretzky's career goals record in 2025.

questions.question: In what year did Wayne Gretzky retire?
questions.explanation: His number 99 was retired league-wide.

questions.question: Who is Canada's captain nicknamed 'Sid the Kid'?
questions.explanation: Crosby has won two Olympic golds for Canada.

questions.question: What is 'icing'?
choices: Shooting the puck across the opponent's goal line from your own half
questions.explanation: Icing stops play.

questions.question: How wide is the NHL goal?
questions.explanation: The goal is 6 ft wide and 4 ft high.

questions.question: Which city's team won the first Stanley Cup after the NHL's creation in 1917?
questions.explanation: The Arenas won the 1918 Cup.

questions.question: What is the Swiss-based governing body of ice hockey?
questions.explanation: The International Ice Hockey Federation is based in Zurich.

questions.question: Which player won the Hart Trophy most times (9)?
questions.explanation: Gretzky won nine MVP awards.
